up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows that have pChEMBL values for IC50 assays measured against the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1994 (Mineralocorticoid receptor). For each row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, organism taxonomy ID (tax_id), canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (which will be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value. Ensure that only rows with a non‑null pChEMBL value are included. Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order, then by assay ChEMBL ID in ascending order, and take the first 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1994' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
